chunks: And from him, from Abu Abdillah al-Barqi, from Ibn Sinan, from Mansur al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no objection to a man enjoying (temporary marriage) with a Majusi (Zoroastrian)."

key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعَ: to enjoy (specifically referring to temporary marriage or mut'ah)

ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim man enter into temporary marriage with a Zoroastrian woman?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Barqi’s collection confirms the permissibility of a Muslim man entering into temporary marriage (Mut'ah) with a Majusi (Zoroastrian) woman, extending the general rule of treating People of the Book as valid spouses. It highlights the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence regarding interfaith unions, distinguishing between permanent and temporary marital contracts in this context.
